claims.note: Degree-compatible recursive reduction and actual-generator Boolean correction are constructed here; no Groebner-basis or exact quotient assertion is assumed.
Probe-dimension branching, selector interpolation, weighted images and asymptotic recurrence are explicit. The missing arbitrary-growing-probe bound is not treated as a dependency theorem.

New exact reductions, matrices and models are direct finite evidence; proposed coefficient splitting is refuted only for the specific tested map.
Explicit full-field telescoping coefficients and old Boolean image ledger give this arity control directly. It is recorded reuse, not a new lower-bound theorem or hidden external interface.
All quadratic generator pullbacks preserve degree; odd-prime affine coordinate changes are deliberately excluded.
Simultaneous image sum and original field-domain ledger are supplied here; no exact quotient dimension is used.
Actual-source bottom normalization and leading-head variable order are explicit; growing tails are preserved, not split into stronger inputs.
Finite conditional models are separated from large symbolic parameter controls; no finite PHP instance is claimed.
Certificate substitution and affine binary Boolean pullbacks are explicit; supplied pair witnesses are premises, not equations added to PHP.
Finite-field inverse polynomial, coordinate projection, Boolean division and polar-rank nonspan argument are written out. No claim that pair certificates come from constant combinations.
Binary CRT coordinate transport is explicit; standard finite-field factor and Chinese-remainder facts are separately attributed below.
Generic finite costed-pair theorem and specialized small-field cyclic corollary have separate dependencies; none changes ENS coefficient domains.
Complete finite output is direct evidence; large parameter checks do not enumerate large fields or PHP models.
All coefficients are eliminated by explicit zero-set assignments; polar rank rules out any affine-pair ideal consequence independently of certificate degree.
The explicit cubic identity is independent local algebra; this is reuse/scope control, not a new lower bound.
The common-subspace codimension inequality is an explicit open antecedent, not a completed general compression result.
Complete matrices, ranks, polar controls and exact local certificates are finite evidence only.

Conjugate coordinate invertibility follows from the explicit linearized-polynomial root argument. Product and twisted-domain identities are computed directly; auxiliary coordinates are never assumed Boolean.
Unital binary coefficient descent is proved directly after original-generator pullback; no multiplicativity or naive trace premise.
Extension degree is charged in image dimension, not field cardinality. No arbitrary tensor diagonalization is assumed.
Kernel matrices, strict remainder controls and focused descent tests are new direct evidence; prior main suite was not rerun for the focused control.

Root multiplicity, Taylor coefficient injectivity and truncated convolution are proved directly from polynomial divisibility and equal dimensions. Ordinary derivatives/factorial division are not used.
Frobenius coefficient domains and minus-index-squared head order are proved explicitly. Weights order terms but do not change ordinary degree.
Independent binary affine probe extension is used for reduction only; PHP and multiplier geometry stay in original bits.
Actual pair count and extension-degree factor are charged; remaining arithmetic and affine maps follow the recorded large-field proof.
Finite complete certificates and original-source models distinguish coefficient extraction from ordinary derivatives; large field cardinalities remain symbolic.
Cyclic monomial supports prove quadratic independence, then elementary span/intersection linear algebra gives r and rho. Zero/unit constant maps are explicit and keep all original input positions.
Parity-separated leading heads and pivot selection are proved explicitly for actual projected inputs; discarded outputs are not adjoined.

Low total rank is handled by explicit basis-prefix coefficients; high affine original-generator cost k+1 is retained. Exact literal affine witness provenance is the same remaining attribution question as555.
